managedApiPolicy: No public UMat/Ocl/GpuMat execution surface is promoted in 5.0.1

opencl.promotionRule: Do not collapse Declared or Available into Verified

cuda.relationship: separate backend; CUDA/GpuMat is not implied by OpenCL or T-API

contextPolicy.scope: thread-local or explicitly owned scoped context
contextPolicy.parallelism: queues are not implicitly shared across managed contexts
contextPolicy.initializationFailure: leave CPU path usable and report backend failure

fallbackPolicy.default: explicit CPU fallback; current published package is CPU-only
fallbackPolicy.performanceClaim: CPU fallback cannot be reported as GPU execution or speed-up

synchronizationPolicy.finishBoundary: explicit wait/Finish and disposal semantics are required before publication
synchronizationPolicy.readback: Mat/read/span/native-pointer borrow is a synchronization point unless explicitly documented
synchronizationPolicy.lifetime: storage cannot be disposed while a queued command references it
synchronizationPolicy.timeout: timeout, cleanup, and driver-reset behavior must be recorded

conversionPolicy.matUmat: borrow, copy, or device transfer must be observable
conversionPolicy.unsupportedFormat: report Unsupported; do not silently change format

benchmarkProtocol.claimRule: kernel-only timing cannot promote an end-to-end GPU claim

requiredEvidence: native producer and independent consumer on a pinned OpenCL ICD/device
explicit context ownership and thread-affinity evidence
Mat/UMat conversion, Finish, readback, timeout, and disposal smoke
CPU fallback and unavailable/unsupported/failed outcome smoke
correctness tolerance and end-to-end benchmark including transfer cost
driver/ICD dependency manifest, package hash, and rollback record
promotionGates: candidate package identity is separate and cannot be selected by the CPU package
Declared, Available, and Verified states are independently reported
OpenCL and CUDA evidence are separate; one backend cannot satisfy the other
at least one native producer and one independent consumer reproduce the same pipeline
support contract, SBOM, closeout, and rollback classify the candidate together
stopConditions: context or queue lifetime is nondeterministic
required driver or ICD dependency is unbounded
pipeline mixes CPU and device work without observable synchronization
numerical tolerance or cleanup behavior is not reproducible
consumer cannot reproduce the producer result or package hash

rollback.onFailure: remove the research profile and retain the CPU-only package matrix

forbiddenClaims: WITH_OPENCL or an OpenCL header proves GPU acceleration
UMat or a DNN OpenCL target enum proves execution on a device
a CPU fallback or kernel-only benchmark proves an end-to-end GPU speed-up
CUDA/GpuMat support is implied by OpenCL/T-API support
QEMU, cross-compilation, or a single developer workstation promotes support
